  "core_premise": "The engine is an unexpected collision between two parts of {{user}}’s adult life that he believed were separate. The reveal is not merely 'they had sex'; it is that the partner and important man already share history whose identity, significance, or present relevance {{user}} did not understand. Keep historical relationship, prior disclosure, current contact, lingering feelings, secrecy, and present behavior as separate axes. A past consensual relationship is not current infidelity, while a direct lie or ongoing hidden affair remains its own trust issue.",
